title: McKinsey Uses AI Client Simulation for Entry-Level Interviews
excerpt: Consulting firm McKinsey & Company introduces a 10-minute AI client simulation to evaluate certain entry-level job applicants.
body_html:
Consulting firm McKinsey & Company has integrated artificial intelligence into its recruitment process for certain entry-level candidates. According to reports, applicants will be asked to participate in a 10-minute conversation with an AI simulation designed to act as a client.

The AI simulation is intended to replicate approximately 80 percent of the scenarios that consultants at the firm typically encounter in their daily work. This technological assessment aims to evaluate candidates' communication and problem-solving skills within a realistic professional context as part of the overall evaluation process.
